Partnerships

Kingdomland Kids for churches, ministries & schools

Sunday is one hour. Kingdomland is the other six days. Give every family in your congregation a Bible-first alternative to Saturday-morning cartoons — with a partner rate and a code that's yours.

Start a partnershipSee the shows

A rate for your families

Your congregation gets a promo code with a partner price on the monthly plan, plus the annual plan's free storybook. You share one link; we handle the rest.

Ready-made ministry content

Use Marvelous Light, Bible Adventures and Fruits of Virtue episodes in children's church, with discussion prompts that match what you're already teaching.

A bridge between Sundays

Memory verse tracks and quiz games let families keep this week's lesson going at home — so kids walk in Sunday already humming the verse.

How it works

Three steps, one week

1

Tell us about your church

Name, size, and who leads children's ministry. Two minutes with the form below or an email to hello@kingdomlandkids.com.

2

Get your code and launch kit

A promo code for your families, a one-page flyer, a slide for Sunday announcements and a short video to play from the stage.

3

Families sign up in a minute

They visit go.kingdomlandkids.com, enter your code and start watching that night. You get a monthly note on how many families joined.

Start a partnership

Tell us about your congregation

A real person reads every message and replies within two business days. Prefer email? Write to hello@kingdomlandkids.com.

“Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.”Matthew 19:14

Your email app should have opened with everything filled in. If it didn't, write to hello@kingdomlandkids.com.
